subject: general
question:
Find the wrong term in the following series.

5, 10, 9, 14, 11, 16, 15, 20, 16, 22
solution:
The pattern follows here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a54e616f1ea98180e3837c0f22c778e7bad55584b9c8ef357fbf1085fb05531e.png] 

16 which is the wrong term doesn't follow the pattern here.

The correct series with the common pattern of +4, +2, +4, +2 is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/649b8a625c82cb9dbbace181355e8876c07b327aec5478d37697108bfe53f250.png] 

there should be 17 in the place of 16.

Hence, the correct answer is **"16".**
